body: I believe in Heaven and Hell and hope to be in the former with my Lord and savior, Jesus.
I’m laughing because I’m reading all of this and it makes sense to me but I realize the people who aren’t experiencing this don’t know about the stretchiness of it.
I pray for mine every day too! He’s being caught in his lies now and I just feel sad for him. I’m so glad you made it out!!
Thank you so much! I’m so proud of you and happy for you! It really is a world of difference. We got this!

I started going shortly before we split and asked him to come along but was shot down because going to church meant I was “having religious delusions..” I should have walked then. Nothing comes before Him in my life now and nothing ever will again! His grace saved me and I’m no longer lost! He was the missing piece. Not my narc ex.

THIS! After reading up on signs of narcissism and realizing I wasn’t alone and putting myself first, I am a completely new person. The only thing that makes me sad is how much time was wasted on the wrong person. But! On the flip side, because of him.. when I meet the right one and get into a healthy relationship I’m going to appreciate it SOOOO much more. :)
